title: No runtime test enforces the task list --across-refs manifest `fields` against the keys the command emits
description: Found by the QCLI-432 confirmatory review. The declared-fields-present assertion covers task view/list/search only (test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts), so nothing fails when the manifest `fields` for `task list --across-refs` drifts from the keys the command actually emits. QCLI-432's round-1 review found exactly that drift (the new `identity` was emitted but undeclared) -- caught by a reviewer, not by a guard. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A runtime test fails when a key emitted by `task list --across-refs` is not declared in that command's manifest `fields`, and it is exercised by the emitted `identity` key

finalSummary:
Added a runtime test in test/qcli417-across-refs.test.ts (QCLI-475) that reads the `task list --across-refs` entry's declared `fields` from `quest manifest --json` and compares them against the keys the command actually emits, in both directions: every emitted key must be declared, and every declared field must be emitted. The population is the fixture's dev plus PR 1, and a read that saw nothing fails the row rather than passing it vacuously. The emitted `identity` key -- the one QCLI-432's round-1 review found emitted but undeclared -- is present on every entry and is asserted by the row, so the check is exercised by it.

Proven both ways (AC1): on the correct manifest the row is green; removing `identity` from that command's declared `fields` in src/application/command-contract.ts turns the row red at exactly the emitted-key assertion ("identity" undeclared). The mutation was reverted with `git checkout`, so the delivered change is test-only and src/ is byte-identical to dev.

Why nothing caught it before: the same file already asserts the entry's key set, but hardcoded -- it never reads the manifest, so it pins the keys without tying them to the declaration and cannot fail on drift. This is the across-refs half of the QCLI-137 / QCLI-461 declared-fields test that already covered task view, task list and search.

Verified: `biome check` on the file is clean and `bun run check` exits 0 on the declared bun 1.4.2.
